subject.title: feat: advertise realtime voice provider voices in talk.catalog

question: Should `RealtimeVoiceProviderPlugin.voices` become the permanent public contract for a flat provider-wide set of canonical known voice IDs?
rationale: The branch is technically sound, but only maintainers can commit the Plugin SDK and client ecosystem to flat advisory metadata rather than model-scoped or dynamic voice discovery.

options.title: Sponsor flat-list v1
options.body: Approve the additive provider-wide canonical list now and allow model-scoped or dynamic metadata to layer on later if a concrete provider requires it.

options.title: Require richer discovery
options.body: Replace the field with a model-scoped or dynamic contract before clients and external plugins begin depending on the flat semantics.

options.title: Defer voice discovery
options.body: Keep clients on existing provider-specific behavior until the product has a confirmed cross-provider discovery design.

recommendation.title: Sponsor flat-list v1
recommendation.body: Approve the additive provider-wide canonical list now and allow model-scoped or dynamic metadata to layer on later if a concrete provider requires it.

likelyOwner.reason: Their history spans the realtime voice plugin seam, gateway projection, and newest bundled realtime provider, giving them the strongest available ownership signal for this API choice.
